verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers API fundamentals (pagination, idempotency, version field for optimistic concurrency), webhooks, and MCP server, but no evidence anywhere mentions API versioning scheme (e.g., v1/v2 URI versions with migration paths) or any documented deprecation policy/timeline for retiring API versions or endpoints. Missing for 10: explicit versioned API scheme documentation, deprecation policy or sunset timeline, changelog of breaking changes.
